name: Crimson Company
summary: Two-player bidding and lane-control duel where players recruit mercenaries to conquer two of three castles.
rules_text: Place 3 castle lanes between players. Shuffle 30 character cards, reveal top of deck, put 4 cards on offer. First player starts with 3 coins, second with 4, plus an active-marker. On your turn: 1) Income: gain 3 coins plus any Income effects. 2) Recruitment: place at least 1 coin on exactly one offer card. Opponent must either Match by placing equal coins and taking the coins plus recruiting the card, or Pass and let you recruit it while your coins go to supply. Refill offer to 4 whenever below. You may have max 2 recruited cards in front of you. 3) Deployment: play all your recruited cards onto your side of any remaining lanes, bottommost position. Resolve Deployment effects; face-down cards are 0 strength no effect but can be inspected. 4) Score: check lanes left-to-right; if any side has 4+ cards, resolve Score effects top-to-bottom, sum strengths per side, higher wins castle. On tie lane stays. Destroy all cards in won lane, triggering Destruction effects, and remove lane. Repeat scoring check. First to 2 castles wins.
